title: Three anchored Vibes, one film in no Vibe that they love, one they never spoke about
construction_note: Every Vibe is written with its core (S2), and every core is a film they loved or liked. Hit Man is unfiled with a standing loved verdict — a state today's tools cannot write, so the fixture is seeded through a build from before the vibe rule (seed: pre-vibe-rule; README); Wingwomen is unfiled with no verdict and must never be raised. Logan Lucky, Groundhog Day, The Social Network, The Nice Guys, Paterson, Knives Out and Tenet are absent on purpose: the prompts introduce them.

genres.name: Heist
genres.instruction: A plan, a crew, and the pleasure of watching it go wrong in interesting ways.

genres.name: Easygoing Comedy
genres.instruction: Funny without needing my full attention, and nobody is humiliated for the joke.

genres.name: Talky
genres.instruction: People talking well is the action. Sharp dialogue, and scenes allowed to run long.

genres.name: Time Loop
genres.instruction: The same day again, and what somebody does with it.

vibes.name: Time Well Wasted
vibes.instruction: Light films where being stuck is the joke and nobody has to save the world.

vibes.name: Talk Is the Action
vibes.instruction: Films I watch for how people talk to each other; the plot can wait.

vibes.name: Smooth Operators
vibes.instruction: A crew, a plan, and everybody playing their own angle.

said.because: the loop is the joke and it still lands
